newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan offers 500 bln yen 1.1 pct 4-yr notes--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan offers 500 bln yen 1.1 pct 4-yr notes--MOF.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance said on Tuesday it was offering 500 billion yen worth of 1.1 percent four-year notes through a price-competitive auction.
The auction will close at noon (0300 GMT) and the results will be announced at 2.30 p.m. (0530 GMT).
The issue date will be February 20, 1997 and the maturity date will be February 20, 2001.
